title: David Plays for King Saul
reflectionQuestion: When David played his gentle music, the troubled king felt calm again. What helps your heart feel calm and peaceful?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (David, mature tier). A signature CALM/comfort story (Adam: 'bedtime gold' -- a troubled king, a shepherd boy, soft music, peace returning). Saul's torment by an evil spirit (1 Sam 16:14) is SOFTENED to 'his heart felt sad and troubled... a heavy gloom' -- NO evil-spirit darkness; the gentle music + God's peace bring calm. Distinct David beat from 1801 (giant), 1836 (anointing), 1846 (Jonathan). For a worried/overwhelmed child: routes troubled-feelings -> peace returning. Indelible image = David playing the harp softly, the king's gloom lifting like clouds from the sun. Reuses VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD (David's own voice; warm, shepherd-musician -- perfect content fit). 'God' throughout, no Yahweh.
